name: Villager Recruits 1.15.0 [Forge 1.20.1]
changelog:
**Routes:** 
In the world-map it is now possible to add a route. Routes can be edited and waypoints can be added on the word-map.
Waypoints can be dragged, deleted and edited. Actions can be setup, only the Wait-Action is implemented yet. Routes can be assigned to a Captain or Commander. If the route gets edited the route has to be assigned again.

**Formation Tightness Setting:**
A new button can be toggled to use tighter formations. If toggled the selected formation will have less gaps.

**Hold Formation Setting:**
A new button can be toggled to make recruits hold the formations. If toggled the recruits will not run towards enemies.

**Face-Command:**
If pressed, the selected groups will face the direction you are looking. 
This applies also to formations, they will adjust to the facing.

**Siege Engineer:**
Implementation of the Siege Engineer with compatibility for Siege Weapons Mod. Siege Engineer can steer, reload, repair and shoot the ballista and catapult. Also compatible with face and formation commands.
The Siege Engineer has his own interface where a target priority can be selected. Siege engineers will adapt to all ranged commands like "hold fire" and "fire at will".

**Peace Treaty:**
The leader of a faction can select a new message in the messengers screen. The leader can configure the time a treaty will be active. When done the Messenger will go to the leader of the other faction with the proposal and the item in the main hand. When accepted the messenger will drop the item.

**Embargo:**
On the Messenger Screen the leader of a faction can select players or a complete faction to do a embargo on. A player in this list cannot trade with your Nobles and Villagers(In your factions claim). Merchants from workers will be also compatible. 
The leader can also remove players in this embargo list.

**Fog of War:**
Players that join worlds will have a fog of war on their world-map, they cannot directly see what claim belongs to whom. Can be disabled in config.

**Recruits Starving:**
Configurable feature, must be enabled. Recruits will die slowly when their hunger reaches 0. Noble Villagers and     Patrols are excluded.

**Commander Patrols**
Patrols will now spawn with a Commander as Patrol- Leader. They will have a generated Route to patrol. 
Fixed spawn in other dimensions and in general. (they spawn now naturally)
Commander Patrols

Patrols will now spawn with a Commander as Patrol- Leader. They will have a generated Route to patrol. 
Fixed spawn in other dimensions and in general. (they spawn now naturally)


Fixes: 
+ fixed captain cannon aiming
+ fixed async-core config not working
+ fixed world-map opens in other dimensions
+ fixed world-map dimension overrides
+ fixed recruit take over does not work
+ fixed companions spawns without name from noble villagers
+ fixed hire messages from noble villagers
+ fixed companions spawns with different values
+ fixed Noble walking away after sleeping
+ fixed recruits spawns without data
+ fixed faction screen can be empty
+ fixed ranged units do not take advantage of range when pressing attack
+ fixed muskets still use ammo when config is disabled
+ fixed buckets can be used in claims
+ fixed promoted recruits leave groups
+ fixed crash when navigating big army through doors

#Improvements: 
+ Formation positioning
+ Performance of async threading
+ Performance of Sieges and Claims
+ Scout screen with a checkbox
+ New Admin commands
+ Offline Players will now be shown in the player lists
+ Patrols will spawn in correct skins
+ Added/Improved API for addons
